segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: On the night before He died, Jesus sat with His disciples and told them they would not be left alone.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: I will not leave you comfortless. He was hours from the cross, and He was the one doing the comforting — promising that whatever else they lost that week, they would not be left on their own.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He promised another Helper would come — the Holy Ghost, sent by the Father in His name.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: This Helper would do two things: teach them everything,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: and bring every word Jesus had spoken back to their minds.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: But the Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The Spirit who taught them then teaches everyone who listens now.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You are not left to remember alone. The Comforter is here — let Him teach you.
